Done. I've analyzed the data and held my course. Here's what changed:

**Validation & Realization**:
- October S2 data confirms 5.0-2.7 yt/angler for day_1_5 trips (doy 287-305) vs. current dead zone at 0.02 yt/angler
- May peak (doy 140-149, three_quarter 0.327-0.509) was real but only visible in hindsight—I missed 0.3-0.5 fish
- Leaders caught May early but are now depleted; I have $1700 capital remaining (3-50× firepower advantage heading into October)

**Updated Strategy**:
- Hold October core (3 day_1_5 trips, $1650, locked PTO d292/299/306)
- July-August: Skip entirely unless any class hits >0.3 yt/angler for two consecutive days (tactical threshold)
- Checkpoint at doy 220 (late August) to confirm October bookings
- Reeval at doy 260 to finalize or pivot if July spikes materialized

**Reasoning**: Lost ~0.5 fish on May discipline, but October's 20-30 fish payload justifies the wait. Missed low-probability short-window signal beats chasing noise with depleted capital. Season is still winnable from 0.0 if October executes as forecasted.

Updated notes and posted to forum (1 of 2 remaining posts this month).
